issues.failure_explanation: In the actual definition, the first consistency term contains \(\nabla_h w_h\) rather than \(\nabla_h\phi_h\). Consequently the form is not linear in its second argument and is nonzero at \(\phi_h=0\), directly contradicting the asserted bound. The proof silently uses a different, corrected form. The same defective form appears in both semidiscrete equations.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the first occurrence of \(\avg{D(\cdot)\nabla_h w_h}\) in the SIP consistency terms by \(\avg{D(\cdot)\nabla_h\phi_h}\), and make the scheme and all subsequent uses consistently employ that corrected form.
issues.overall_effect: The stated SIP boundedness result, consistency calculations, pressure error analysis, and concentration error analysis do not apply to the semidiscretization as defined.
issues.title: The defined SIP form is not bilinear
issues.why_classification: The source itself makes the intended symmetric form unambiguous, and one local replacement aligns the definition with all later arguments without changing the method or guarantees.

issues.failure_explanation: The volume term in the definition is independent of the first argument and quadratic in the test function. Taking \(\phi=0\) leaves a generally nonzero volume term while the claimed estimate can be made arbitrarily small with \(\gamma\). The later proof instead estimates the standard term \(-\int \phi\,v\cdot\nabla_h w_h\).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the leading \(w_h\) in the volume term by the trial function \(\phi_h\), consistently throughout the definition and semidiscrete method.
issues.overall_effect: The concentration equation as written is not the asserted linear upwind discretization, and the boundedness and concentration convergence proof do not apply to it.
issues.title: The upwind form omits its trial function in the volume term
issues.why_classification: This is a single local correction whose intended value is fixed by the proof and the standard upwind identity; it preserves all claimed rates and scope.
